verdict.rationale: Intel's marketing repeatedly claims 'smart power efficiency' and performance 'even when you leave the charger behind' with dedicated low-power AI engines, signaling design intent for thin/efficient laptops, but there is no concrete battery-life benchmark data, no mention of specific fanless designs, and no independent/hands-on corroboration in the evidence pack. missing for 10: quantified battery-life hours/benchmarks, confirmation of specific fanless or ultra-thin device implementations, independent reviewer verification of all-day battery claims.
